sharedPrompt: Create a premium cinematic environmental illustration for HomePilot Scene Tale. Environment only: no people, avatar, UI, typography, logos, watermark, or embedded text. Family-friendly. Use a realistic-fantasy / cinematic storybook treatment with layered depth, atmospheric light, a clear focal point, and strong readability at thumbnail size. Keep the center area readable for a wide story-card crop. This is a fictional story setting, not factual local history. Maintain one consistent visual language across the full library: dark-to-mid-tone palette where appropriate, luminous highlights, gentle atmospheric depth, polished immersive detail, and emotionally rich but calm composition.
landscapeComposition: Landscape composition for a 16:9 production backplate. Keep the important focal point within the central 60% horizontally and the scene readable behind a foreground avatar. Leave a believable standing surface or visual grounding near the lower 10-15% when the location includes ground, terrace, shore, path, or garden. No foreground person.
portraitComposition: Portrait composition for a 9:16 production backplate depicting the same recognizable location, lighting, palette, architectural/natural landmarks, and time of day as the landscape version. Recompose independently for portrait rather than cropping the landscape. Keep the important focal point within the central 50% horizontally and preserve a believable lower grounding zone. No foreground person.
